access_log_path.description: Path to the access log file.

auth_realms.description: List of basic authentication realms. Each realm protects a path with a set of username:password_hash pairs.

name.description: Realm name (e.g., 'Restricted Area'), shown in auth prompt.

path.description: URL path prefix protected by this realm.

bind_addr.description: IP address the server listens on. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces or '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only.

connection_timeout.description: Connection idle timeout in seconds before closing.

directory_index.description: If true, shows a directory listing when no index file is present.

document_root.description: Root directory from which static files are served.

enable_gzip.description: Enable gzip compression for text-based responses.

error_log_path.description: Path to the error log file.

max_body_size.description: Maximum allowed HTTP request body size in bytes (e.g., 10 MiB = 10485760).

mime_types.description: Custom MIME type mappings for file extensions. Each entry maps a file extension to a MIME type.

port.description: TCP port the server listens on.

server_token.description: Value for the Server HTTP response header. Set to empty string to hide server identity.

ssl.description: TLS/SSL configuration to enable HTTPS. If null or omitted, only HTTP is served.

cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file.

key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads. Set to the number of CPU cores for optimal performance.
